read_assignment.assignment: lowest common ancestor of both mates' near-tied hits
read_assignment.host_references: assembled SSUs whose SILVA best hit lies in Siphonophorae

validated_reads.calibration: one above the maximum negative-control background (36 pairs; Insecta, Embryophyta, non-human Mammalia)

presence.validated_assembled: non-host full-length SSU assembled by phyloFlash or on the library's own Phase-3 assembly (barrnap 18S)
presence.high_confidence: validated by reads and by an assembled SSU of the same reporting unit in the same library
read_level_exclusions: unresolved lineages at or above Metazoa or its ancestors

naming_depth.lt90: novel lineage at class or phylum

verification: NCBI BLAST of assembled non-host SSUs for key taxa

role_field.note: role is a biological interpretation recorded as an evidence field, not a classifier bin
role_field.amendment_2026_09_30: Kinetoplastea replaced by Trypanosomatida: SILVA places the obligate Paramoeba endosymbiont (PLO, Perkinsela) within Prokinetoplastina/Ichthyobodo, so lineage alone cannot separate it from parasitic kinetoplastids; detections whose NCBI top hit is the PLO are labelled endosymbiont of Paramoeba (approved by Casey Dunn)

contamination_flag: human (Homo) only; single-library detections are kept

assembled_classification.note: both assembled sources are LCA-classified against the same competitive reference as the reads
